FIKTIVA CITY CODE (FICTIONAL, INVENTED FOR TESTS, NOT LAW)

CHAPTER I General

Article 1 Public notice
INVENTED TEXT. The City of Fiktiva publishes every public notice on its
municipal board for fourteen days.

Article 2 Gatherings
INVENTED TEXT. A gathering of fewer than fifty people on a street needs no permit.

CHAPTER II Water

Article 3 Fountains
INVENTED TEXT. Public fountains are kept open from spring to autumn.

Article 4 Wells
INVENTED TEXT. A well may not be closed without a public notice.

Article 10 Appeals
INVENTED TEXT. A resident may appeal any decision of the board within thirty days.
